official_definition: Ultra Assault: - (When Attacks) After the battle, this spirit can be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses. After that, move 1 core from your opponent's lives to their reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultra Assault] or [Ultra Assault: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultra Assault]", "give [Ultra Assault]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
